column1: # PLANTPOTTING-0011 — machine-checkable attribution manifest for identify-fixtures/.
# Tab-separated. One row per *.jpg fixture. Parsed by FixtureLicenseManifestTest (license
# cross-check) and FixtureIntegrityTest (decode + KB-resolution + in-vocab reachability).
# Policy (PLANTPOTTING-0011 non-goal): NEW fixtures added this sprint MUST be CC0 / public-domain.
# Four pre-existing fixtures are CC BY-SA and are GRANDFATHERED (they predate the CC0/PD-only rule
# and one — monstera-deliciosa.jpg — is the AIY baseline anchor, so it cannot be swapped):
# The cross-check test fails if ANY other fixture declares a non-CC0/PD license, or if a fixture
# lacks a row here. Human prose provenance lives alongside in LICENSE.txt.
